besluite.rede: 'Hulle ontmoet mekaar' is established Afrikaans for two oceans meeting (it is the standard phrase for Cape Agulhas), so the proposal is a lateral move.

besluite.fout: 'lees ... op die kaart' is a loose verb for taking information from a map, and the bare present reads stiffly after 'hoef nie'.
besluite.rede: 'aflees' is the exact verb, and 'kan eerder' reads naturally as the alternative to memorising without changing what the learner does.

besluite.fout: Without a pause, 'Afrika wys met die ewenaar' can be misread as showing Africa by means of the equator.
besluite.rede: The comma attaches 'met die ewenaar' to the map and removes the stumble without changing the content.

besluite.fout: 'ontmoet' is used without an object, an English-style intransitive use.
besluite.rede: 'bymekaarkom' is correct, natural Afrikaans and says the same thing.

besluite.fout: 'by die naam leesbaar' is not an Afrikaans expression.
besluite.rede: Saying the names must be legible is the plain wording, and the following 'tussen hulle' still clearly means the countries in this instruction.
In this glossary definition 'daarvoor' can only point to 'n land' in the same sentence, so it is not vague, and the rewording would change a definition only the writer may change.
